label: Iran
definition: Substantive discussion of Iran: its government, security, nuclear program, sanctions, human rights, diplomacy or explicitly linked regional actions. Do not infer presence from Middle East, Gaza, Gulf or Hormuz alone. A nationality adjective in a cultural quotation or speaker metadata alone does not qualify.

label: Cuba
definition: Substantive discussion of Cuba: embargo, sanctions, terrorism-list designation, energy restrictions, political or human-rights conditions, development, assistance or bilateral relations. Do not infer presence from Latin America or sanctions in general. A greeting, list of visiting delegations or speaker metadata alone does not qualify.

label: Ukraine
definition: Substantive discussion of Ukraine, the Russia-Ukraine war, assistance, sovereignty, reconstruction, refugees or directly linked European/Black Sea security. Generic references to Russia or the Black Sea without a Ukraine connection do not qualify.

label: AI
definition: Substantive discussion of artificial intelligence: governance, models, capability, access, investment, risk, safety, applications, standards or AI-enabled weapons. Generic digitalization, cyber policy, connectivity, algorithms or technology do not qualify without an explicit AI connection. Do not transfer a broad AI & digital code into this narrower category.

label: UN reform & representation
definition: Institutional reform, UN80, Security Council membership or veto, UN leadership selection. Mere thanks to the UN does not qualify.
extractive_regex: UN80|Security Council reform|reform.{0,65}(United Nations|UN\b|Security Council)|permanent seat|veto

label: Human rights, health & social
definition: Human rights, public health, education, gender, children, youth or social policy. Require a substantive statement, not a ceremonial greeting.

label: Other peace & security
definition: Peacekeeping, terrorism, organized crime, disarmament or conflicts outside Ukraine/Russia and the Middle East. Do not count generic peace language alone.

label: AI & digital
definition: AI, digital or cyber governance, capability, access, harms, standards or safeguards. Do not count generic technology without an AI/digital connection.

label: Development & finance
definition: Development finance, debt, SDGs, jobs, industrialization, investment or technology transfer. Broad category; independent of whether the speaker favors a policy.

label: Climate & environment
definition: Climate mitigation, adaptation, finance, oceans, biodiversity, water security or environmental policy.

label: Middle East
definition: Israel, Palestine, Gaza, Iran, Gulf, Hormuz, Golan or explicitly linked regional issues.

label: Humanitarian, migration & refugees
definition: Humanitarian assistance/access, migration, refugees, displacement, asylum or returns.

label: Sovereignty & territorial disputes
definition: Specific sovereignty, territorial, self-determination or decolonization disputes. Generic Charter sovereignty language alone does not qualify.
